notes.title: Build 124216
notes.content:
**Build 124216 release notes:**
* Schematics: v1 (Note: This system is still in active development)
  - Select one or more buildings and press Ctrl+C to create a Schematic
  - Place the last created Schematic with Ctrl+V
  - Schematics currently support all stationary units except belts
  - Save/Load and belt support coming soon™

* Resources
  - Iron extracts at a rate of 4 per second, down from 8 per second
  - Steel now requires 2 Iron, down from 3
  - Resources can now only be extracted by one extractor at a time

* Early Access Scenarios
  - “Artillery Assault” removed
  - Learn: Artillery added to Early Access Scenarios menu (mission is still a work in progress)
  - Adjustments to Enemy Assault mission resources and difficulty

* User Interface
  - Updated Help Menu layout and content
  - Updated Power layout in Unit Info Panel
  - Updated tutorial page scroll box clipping
  - Fixed some bugs that would prevent the power info widget from displaying info for some units.
  - Fixed issue where escape menu buttons needed to be pressed multiple times to return to main menu.

* Other
  - Fixed issue with belts not crossing over each other in scenarios
  - Fixed artillery shells continuing after hitting certain targets

notes.title: Dec 21 New Update Available: 124067
notes.content:
GENERAL
- Added 2 EA Scenarios
   - Learn: Logistics
   - Learn: Power
- Added Sandbox map selector
- Additional Localization added
- Crash Fixes

UNITS
- Redesigned Titan Gantry
- Commander will now always build at 100% efficiency
- Basic Fabs (Forge, Snapsync, Max, Silismith) now cost 18 Iron, down from 20
- Belts can now be anchored during placement with the "Place Belt" key (Default is B)
   - Anchors can be removed with Right Mouse Button
- Double Clicking a belt section now selects all connected belts
- All belt segments now indicate valid placement based on distance to allied units.
   - Valid allied units currently include: Commander, Stationary Units that have begun building
- Updated Port Highlighting
- Updated Placement Visual Effects for many units
- Enemy units are no longer visible nor block placement until beginning building
- Stretch (Connector) unit ghost and placement materials updated
- Zephyr (Wind Generator) size reduced by 25%

USER INTERFACE
- Updated Help Menu
- Updated Resource Filter

KEYBINDS
- B -> Begin placing a Glidstream (Belt)
- G -> Begin placing a Stretch (Connector)

notes.title: Dec 16 New Update Available: 123940
notes.content:
Input Improvements
    - Belts and Connectors can now be built using Click/Drag or the original two click method
    - Belts now favor the direction the cursor moved away from the initial placement location
    - Structures now rotate towards the cursor during placement using Click/Drag

New Input Bindings
    - C -> Select Commander (Can be rebound)
    - Double Press C -> Focus Commander (Uses the same binding as Select Commander)
    - F -> Select Idle Fabber closest to mouse location (Can be rebound)
    - Double Press F -> Select All Idle Fabbers (Uses the same binding as Select Idle Fabber)
    - E -> Focus Enemy Commander (Can be rebound)

General Fixes
    - Fixed issue that caused connectors to not be visible in certain situations

-Extractors now show what resource they are extracting in the Info Panel
-Steel now takes 3.5 seconds to build, down from 4 seconds. This should better indicate optimal resource inputs

-Sky Arc (Power Transmission Tower) now has a larger power radius with increased construction cost

-Control Group crash fixes
-Fixed elusive belt crash. Huge shoutout to @Southpaw and @Qmzn working through the night to find a reliable repro
-Fixed crash when non-host disconnects
